changes.value: Blue is the single action colour (#006cbc, white text 5.4:1). Deep navy (#044788) is for the announcement bar, footer and headings on tinted bands. Green (#43b14a in the logo) is a brand accent for badges, highlights and illustration only. Text and buttons use a darker green (#2b7d32, white text 5.1:1) because the logo green fails contrast. Teal is dropped.

Header, buttons and links use blue. The announcement bar and footer use navy. Feature tiles rotate blue, navy, green (#2b7d32) and ink (#0a1d33), each with white text above 4.5:1. Dark theme uses a light blue primary (#6ab7f5) on a deep navy-black ground.
